use_case_policy.note: not default; contrast or special slow scene only

source_user_observation: However, the best duration depends on the scene.

choreography_rules: every motion must have a scene function
expression changes must be tied to a beat reason
do not repeat nodding unless the scene calls for repeated acknowledgement
do not use body forward/back movement unless it expresses a clear action
use 0.75s / 45 frames as the default light reenactment beat
use 0.5s / 30 frames only for quick reaction, punch, or short emphasis
use 1.0s / 60 frames for slower explanatory or readability-heavy moments
keep 1.5s / 90 frames as a slow comparison or special-case upper bound
prefer short active motion plus readable hold
avoid cheap-looking tilt loops by limiting nod count and using neutral return
treat cards and overlays as optional support, not the animation target

scene_beat_integration_risks.mitigation: use the tempo policy inside an actual scene/beat structure
select 0.5s, 0.75s, or 1.0s by beat function instead of forcing one global value
do not use 1.5s as default; reserve it for contrast or a specific slow scene

scene_beat_mapping.viewer_information_goal: show the character is present and listening before the reaction starts
scene_beat_mapping.character_state_before: neutral stable pose at shared anchor
scene_beat_mapping.motion_reason: no movement; this beat prevents immediate primitive playback
scene_beat_mapping.expression_reason: calm listening state before the question cue
scene_beat_mapping.facing_policy: neutral front-facing proxy; no facing flip is claimed
scene_beat_mapping.transition_policy: hard scene start into stable pose

scene_beat_mapping.viewer_information_goal: mark that a question or concern has appeared
scene_beat_mapping.motion_reason: expression change carries the reaction; body stays anchored
scene_beat_mapping.expression_reason: concerned reaction to the question cue
scene_beat_mapping.facing_policy: keep facing stable; do not imply walking backward
scene_beat_mapping.transition_policy: instant expression swap at beat boundary followed by readable hold
scene_beat_mapping.fallback_if_primitive_unavailable: hold neutral expression and mark expression binding unresolved

scene_beat_mapping.viewer_information_goal: show a single acknowledgement before explanation continues
scene_beat_mapping.motion_reason: one nod acknowledges the question; it is not repeated
scene_beat_mapping.expression_reason: return to explanation-ready confidence after the question cue
scene_beat_mapping.facing_policy: head tilt only; no body direction change
scene_beat_mapping.anchor_policy: hold X=-96 while the nod returns to neutral
scene_beat_mapping.transition_policy: 45-frame active nod followed by neutral hold
scene_beat_mapping.fallback_if_primitive_unavailable: skip nod and rely on the expression return to easy

scene_beat_mapping.viewer_information_goal: mark the moment where the explanation turns to risk or caution
scene_beat_mapping.motion_reason: expression change carries emphasis; no extra body motion is needed
scene_beat_mapping.expression_reason: risk/caution emphasis rather than mechanical sequence
scene_beat_mapping.transition_policy: instant expression swap at beat boundary followed by readable hold
scene_beat_mapping.fallback_if_primitive_unavailable: hold easy expression and mark caution expression unresolved

scene_beat_mapping.viewer_information_goal: show one small emphasis move tied to the caution point
scene_beat_mapping.motion_reason: small nudge underlines emphasis, then returns to the shared anchor
scene_beat_mapping.expression_reason: same caution expression holds while the body makes one intentional nudge
scene_beat_mapping.facing_policy: lateral nudge only; no forward/back or facing claim
scene_beat_mapping.fallback_if_primitive_unavailable: drop the nudge and keep the caution expression

scene_beat_mapping.viewer_information_goal: settle the scene back into a stable explanation pose
scene_beat_mapping.motion_reason: no movement; the beat closes the mini-scene cleanly
scene_beat_mapping.expression_reason: return from caution to explanation-ready tone
scene_beat_mapping.facing_policy: neutral front-facing proxy; no facing flip is claimed
scene_beat_mapping.transition_policy: instant expression return followed by readable hold
scene_beat_mapping.fallback_if_primitive_unavailable: hold previous expression and mark close expression unresolved

structure: Beat C: one short nod or acknowledgement
Beat D: expression changes for reason
Beat E: one small intentional nudge
Beat F: return to stable explanation pose
demonstrates: 0.75s default active timing in a scene-beat structure
